import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { customer } from "./customer";
import { invoiceLine } from "./invoice_line";

export const invoice = defineTable("invoice", {
    columns: {
        invoiceId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        customerId: col.integer().notNull(),
        invoiceDate: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        billingAddress: col.varchar({ length: 70 }),
        billingCity: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        billingState: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        billingCountry: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        billingPostalCode: col.varchar({ length: 10 }),
        total: col.numeric({ precision: 10, scale: 2 }).notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        customer: rel.belongsTo(() => customer, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        invoice_line: rel.hasMany(() => invoiceLine)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
